summary.zh: 定日镜聚光 → 中央吸热塔 → 冷热熔盐储罐 → 蒸汽发电；100 MWe / 2000 MWhth 教学示意。
summary.en: Heliostats → central receiver → two-tank molten-salt storage → steam generation. Illustrative 100 MWe / 2000 MWhth.

principle.zh: 双轴定日镜将太阳光反射至塔顶吸热器；三维显示代表性镜位，容量按额定有效镜面面积计算。
principle.en: Two-axis mirrors reflect sunlight onto the tower receiver. The 3D field is representative; capacity uses the configured effective mirror area.

principle.zh: 聚焦光束加热管内熔盐，冷盐升温后进入热盐罐。此处采用熔盐，不是熔化岩石。
principle.en: Concentrated sunlight heats salt in receiver tubes; hot salt enters storage. This scene uses molten salt, rather than melting rocks.

signature.zh: IR hotspot and flux imbalance agree / 热像热点与热流不均匀度同时升高
signature.en: IR hotspot and flux imbalance agree / 热像热点与热流不均匀度同时升高

principle.zh: 高温熔盐以显热形式储能；SOC 表示可用热能，单位 MWhth。
principle.en: Hot salt stores sensible heat; SOC represents available thermal energy in MWhth.

principle.zh: 放热后的熔盐仍保持液态，回到冷罐并重新泵入吸热器。
principle.en: Salt remains liquid after releasing heat and returns to the cold tank before being pumped to the receiver.

principle.zh: 泵的流量由吸热功率及盐的比热、温差计算；轴承磨损同时影响流量、振动、声学和温度。
principle.en: Flow follows absorbed heat, salt heat capacity and temperature rise. Bearing wear changes flow, vibration, sound and temperature together.

signature.zh: Vibration, bearing heat and acoustic energy rise together / 振动、轴温及声学能量同时升高
signature.en: Vibration, bearing heat and acoustic energy rise together / 振动、轴温及声学能量同时升高

principle.zh: 热盐通过换热器产生蒸汽；熔盐和水汽回路分离。
principle.en: Hot salt generates steam through a heat exchanger; salt and water/steam stay in separate circuits.

principle.zh: 蒸汽驱动汽轮发电机；即使辐照归零，储热罐放热仍可驱动机组。
principle.en: Steam drives the turbine-generator. Stored heat can keep it running when irradiance falls to zero.

principle.zh: 冷端排热与发电功率共同闭合汽轮循环的热量收支。
principle.en: Heat rejection and generated electricity close the power-cycle heat balance.

principle.zh: 发电机出口升压至 220 kV 送出；油温和 DGA 由同一合成负荷与故障驱动。
principle.en: Generator voltage is stepped up to 220 kV; oil temperature and DGA share one synthetic load/fault state.

signature.zh: Oil temperature, IR and DGA rise together / 油温、红外及 DGA 同步升高
signature.en: Oil temperature, IR and DGA rise together / 油温、红外及 DGA 同步升高

principle.zh: 上网功率扣除厂用电和主变损耗，电流按三相功率计算。
principle.en: Net export deducts auxiliaries and transformer loss; current follows three-phase power.
